about: The collecta of the formulary “Saint Lawrence, Martyr” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, to extinguish the flames of our sins, as You granted St. Lawrence to overcome the fires of his tortures. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
